sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2003
ACT I OF 2003
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF
MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 26th February, 2003]
No. PAB/Legis: V(1)2003, dated
26-2-2003.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 25th February, 2003 and assented
to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement:---(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Chief Minister
and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act,
2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

5. Substitution of section 7
Act-III of 1975.---In the said Act, for section 7, the following shall be
substituted.
"7. Transport:--The
Chief Minister and a Minister shall be entitled to the use of two vehicles
maintained at Government expense throughout his term of office and for a period
of 15 days immediately thereafter (one without ceiling and the second vehicle
may use 250 litters fuel per month".

[Gazette of

No. PAB/Legis: V(1)2003, dated
26-2-2003.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 25th February, 2003 and assented

Provincial Assembly:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
6. Substitution of section 7-A
of Act-III of 1975.--In the said Act; for section 7-A, the following shall
be substituted;
"7-A. Telephone:--A
Minister shall be entitled to telephone facilities at office without ceiling
and at residence up to a maximum ceiling of ten thousand rupees both for
official and private purpose throughout the term of his office and for a period
of fifteen days immediately thereafter. He will also be entitled to free
telephone facility while on tour where such facility is available".

No. PAB/Legis: V(1)2003, dated
26-2-2003.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 25th February, 2003 and assented

Provincial Assembly:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
8. Substitution of section 8-A
of Act III of 1975.-In the said Act, for section 8-A, the following shall
be substituted, namely:--
"8-A. Hiring Ceiling.-If
the Chief Minister chooses to reside in his own house he shall be paid a
monthly rent of thirty thousand rupees. Where official accommodation is not'
available, and a Minister shall be provided rented residence up to a maximum
ceiling of twenty five thousand rupees per month. If a Minister chooses to
reside in. his own house, he shall be paid a monthly rent of fifteen thousand
rupees per month.
